text: A consequence of Fodor's Language of Thought hypothesis is that natural language is not the medium of thought but a means of expressing thoughts already formed in Mentalese.
explanation: True. LOT makes the private, innate Mentalese the medium of thought and treats public languages as vehicles for communicating it -- the reverse of the Wittgensteinian/Whorfian view that language shapes or constitutes thought. Fodor even argues that language learning presupposes prior Mentalese concepts.
